coach.name: Billy Donlon
coach.since: Hired March 17, 2026 (introduced March 26) as the program's 31st head coach; 2026-27 is his first season
coach.notes: Came from Clemson, where he was associate head coach. Prior head coaching record 155-133 (Wright State, UMKC) per Wikipedia MAC season page. Replaced Stan Heath, who mutually parted ways with EMU on March 8, 2026 after a 10-21 season (57-99 in five years). Eastern Echo says he prioritizes evaluation over salesmanship, stresses emotional discipline and selflessness, and has a goal of the program's first sellout at the George Gervin GameAbove Center. Contract terms not found in sources checked. Donlon has an active X account (quoted by emueagles.com on Habhab's return) but the handle was not captured.

previews.title: 2026-27 MAC Men's basketball season preview
previews.author: Ruby Brannon
previews.projected_finish: Middle of the pack (per preseason poll); article says Eagles could disrupt the hierarchy
previews.summary: League-wide preview that places EMU in the middle tier but argues the Eagles could disrupt the MAC hierarchy and compete in March under first-year coach Billy Donlon. Preseason All-MAC first-teamer Mohammad Habhab is described as the conference's premier interior catalyst who can guard one through five and facilitate from the high post. Braelon Green is cited as a key contributor after a strong summer and Emanuel Richards as a scoring punch who led EMU in points on the Canadian tour. Donlon's culture emphasis (evaluation, emotional discipline, selflessness) and sellout goal are noted. Names Miami, Ball State, Toledo and Akron as the top tier.

previews.title: 2026-27 Mid-American Men's Basketball Overview
previews.author: Kaily "KG" Godek (EMU section); Foster Roesti
previews.summary: Says Donlon has work to do to return EMU to the MAC Tournament after a 10-21 season. Habhab is crucial to rebounding and defense. Transfers Kaden Johnson (NAIA Huntington, 17.2/11.4, Crossroads League DPOY), Kilian Brockhoff (William & Mary), Emanuel Richards (Longwood) and Jabri Fitzpatrick (New Haven, NEC second team) are profiled. Departures include Addison Patterson, Jon Sanders II and Mak Manciel (graduated), Godslove Nwabude (to Kent State) and Carlos Hart (left midseason). Non-conference includes road games at Xavier and Louisville and the Cancun Challenge.

storylines.headline: Donlon era begins after Stan Heath's exit
storylines.detail: Heath and EMU parted ways March 8, 2026 after 10-21 (57-99 in five seasons). Clemson associate HC Billy Donlon hired March 17 as 31st head coach; Eastern Echo (Apr. 29) covered his new-look staff: Martin McGillan (associate HC), John Bowler, Vince Fritz, Hassan Nizam, Cam Carter (assistants).

storylines.headline: Habhab pulled out of the portal and returned as preseason first-team All-MAC
storylines.detail: Announced Apr. 27, 2026; Donlon posted on X: 'The Big Fella is out of the portal and will be back at the George Gervin Game Above Center!' Habhab had EMU's first triple-double (24/11/10 vs. Oakland, Nov. 21, 2025) and was one of four players nationally at 14/8/3.

storylines.headline: Opening-night thriller: Habhab 34-point double-double in 71-70 win at Coastal Carolina
storylines.detail: Donlon's debut on Nov. 2 produced a one-point MAC-SBC Challenge win with 11 ties and 13 lead changes; Habhab had 34 pts, 13 reb and went 18-of-21 at the line, JUCO transfer Jaiden Martin added 17.

storylines.headline: Reality check at Xavier, 76-53
storylines.detail: After an early surge EMU trailed 34-25 at half and lost by 23 in Cincinnati on Nov. 6; Richards 13 off the bench, Martin 12 (4-6 3PT), Habhab 11/7.

storylines.headline: Rebuilt roster: 10 of 13 players new or from lower levels
storylines.detail: Transfers from Longwood, New Haven, William & Mary, Huntington (NAIA), Delta State, Quincy, Lake Superior State, Oakland CC and Parkland CC join returners Habhab, Lawson II and Green; freshman Aviv Aronov from Tel Aviv via Huntington Prep. Canadian exhibition tour in August (90-69 at Windsor, 87-49 vs. McMaster) and exhibition at defending champion Michigan Oct. 11.

recent_news.headline: Habhab's 34-point double-double lifts EMU past Coastal Carolina 71-70 in Donlon's debut
recent_news.detail: MAC-SBC Challenge opener at Coastal Carolina (Conway, S.C.), Donlon's debut. 11 ties, 13 lead changes; neither team led by more than four in the second half. Habhab 34 pts, 13 reb, 18-of-21 FT; Jaiden Martin 17 pts (6-11 FG, 3-6 3PT), 3 stl; Kaden Johnson 8 pts. EMU 23-of-29 (79.3%) from the line. Coastal: Trey Perry 20. Recap by Ruby Brannon; no coach quotes.

recent_news.headline: EMU surges early, falls 76-53 at Xavier
recent_news.detail: Trailed 34-25 at half; EMU now 1-1. Richards 13 pts/8 reb off bench; Martin 12 (4-6 3PT) as a starter; Habhab 11/7; Green 6 ast; Fitzpatrick 6 pts/4 ast; Johnson 3 stl. No injuries reported. Next: Great Lakes Christian at home Nov. 11.
